authority: CEO Round 188: Close H1-V2. Do not keep narrowing. Generate successors from information bottleneck. Add SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED_WHEN_MARGINAL_NOVELTY_REMAINS_LOW.

h1_v2_closure.the_finding: 3 of 4 elements are prior art (biofouling sensor=USC 2019, AI prediction=US 20260115436, obstruction classification=US20220355086A1). The 4th (biofouling trajectory prediction) is a natural extension. The combination is plausibly obvious under KSR.
h1_v2_closure.the_lesson: Scientifically validated != inventively differentiated. A candidate can demonstrate genuine scientific capability (R2=0.691, 90.7% discrimination, 147-day lead) but fail the inventive-step test because its components are individually known and the combination is obvious.
h1_v2_closure.cemetery_lesson: Do not combine an existing physical sensor, known AI prediction, and known failure classification and mistake the resulting system architecture for a new invention.

new_loop_rule.name: SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED_WHEN_MARGINAL_NOVELTY_REMAINS_LOW
new_loop_rule.rule: If a candidate has Level 5+ scientific evidence AND strong commercial value BUT Gate 2 fails after ONE deep obviousness search: CLOSE the candidate, PRESERVE scientific results, GENERATE a new mechanism. No V3/V4/V5 of the same concept. One redefinition max (V1->V2). If V2 fails Gate 2, candidate is CLOSED.
new_loop_rule.anti_pattern: Claim drafting by iteration = changing wording or narrowing scope until patent appears to survive. FORBIDDEN.

information_bottleneck_analysis.the_bottleneck: Existing systems observe EFFECTS and PREDICT failure. They cannot observe WHERE degradation occurs, WHY it is happening, the LATENT MECHANICAL STATE, or predict WHICH INTERVENTION will work.

four_new_directions.name: Spatial Degradation Localization
four_new_directions.question: Can the system determine WHERE inside a shunt degradation is occurring without direct imaging?
four_new_directions.bottleneck: All sensors measure AGGREGATE state. None measure SPATIAL DISTRIBUTION along the catheter.
four_new_directions.potential_invention: Multi-point sensing array along catheter for spatial localization of degradation

four_new_directions.name: Causal Root-Cause Diagnosis
four_new_directions.question: WHY is failure rising? What is the safest diagnostic perturbation that discriminates between causes?
four_new_directions.bottleneck: Systems predict THAT failure is coming. None determine WHY via active causal inference.
four_new_directions.potential_invention: Active causal inference: observe -> hypothesize -> perturb -> infer cause -> recommend intervention
four_new_directions.key_distinction_from_WO2011146757A2: WO2011146757A2 detects obstruction (binary). Causal diagnosis DISCRIMINATES between multiple failure modes (multi-class).

four_new_directions.name: Latent Mechanical State Estimation
four_new_directions.question: Can the system infer hidden mechanical quantities from NATURALLY OCCURRING perturbations?
four_new_directions.bottleneck: Pressure/flow are observable. Hydraulic resistance distribution, compliance, valve hysteresis are HIDDEN STATES.
four_new_directions.potential_invention: State estimator using natural physiological perturbations (posture, cough, CSF pulsation) as excitation — sidesteps WO2011146757A2 which uses ACTIVE vibration

four_new_directions.name: Intervention Outcome Prediction
four_new_directions.question: WHICH intervention will restore the patient's physiological state with least risk?
four_new_directions.bottleneck: Systems predict FAILURE. None predict INTERVENTION OUTCOME.
four_new_directions.potential_invention: Diagnose -> simulate each intervention -> predict outcome -> recommend best intervention/risk ratio

state.next_action: Deep novelty search for all 4 directions
